observation.visible_scene: A winter riverbank under overcast light: a dark, flowing river fills the upper-left, bordered along the lower-right by a thick bank of rounded white snow/ice mounds. A snow-covered far shoreline with bare trees runs across the top. A small brown leaf rests on the snow mound at right. Snow is falling continuously throughout the clip.
visible_changes: Falling snow appears as white streaks and dots that change position frame to frame, drifting downward and slightly diagonally across both the dark water and the bright snow.
The dark water surface shows shifting ripples and small patches of white foam/turbulence near the snow edge, indicating ongoing downstream flow; the pattern of these ripples changes between frames.

The snow/ice mounds, the far bank, and the resting leaf keep identical positions and shapes across all frames, and the overall framing does not change, indicating a static camera and no visible accumulation or deformation of the snow within this segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether snowfall begins, intensifies, or stops outside this window; the long-term rate of snow accumulation on the bank; the origin/formation of the rounded ice-snow mounds; the wider river course beyond the frame.
uncertain_details: Exact flow direction and speed of the river (texture suggests leftward/downstream motion but no discrete tracer confirms it); any very slight camera drift is indistinguishable from a fixed tripod view given the unchanging background.
